# ankra_cloudflare_credential (Resource)

A Cloudflare API token connected to the organisation. The platform verifies the token when it is connected; `ankra_cloudflare_dns_record` and `ankra_organisation_custom_dns_zone` use it by name. The token cannot be changed in place, so a new token replaces the credential. Destroying it deletes the credential, which the platform refuses while a cluster uses it. The counterpart of `ankra org cloudflare connect`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "ankra_cloudflare_credential" "main" {
  name      = "cloudflare-main"
  api_token = var.cloudflare_api_token
}

variable "cloudflare_api_token" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `api_token` (String, Sensitive) Cloudflare API token with DNS edit access to the zones it should manage. The platform never returns it, so a change made outside Terraform is not detected.
- `name` (String) Credential name, unique among the organisation's credentials. Changing it replaces the credential.

### Optional

- `account_id` (String) Cloudflare account, needed only for an account-owned token that reaches several accounts. When unset the platform records the account the token resolves to. Changing it replaces the credential.

### Read-Only

- `account_name` (String) Name of the Cloudflare account.
- `id` (String) Identifier of the credential.
- `needs_reconnect` (Boolean) Whether the token is gone and the credential must be connected again.
- `state` (String) Health of the credential; `needs-reconnect` once the platform no longer holds the token.
- `token_expires_at` (String) When the token expires, if it does.
- `token_id` (String) Cloudflare's id for the token.
- `token_kind` (String) Whether the token is user-owned or account-owned.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Cloudflare credentials are imported by name. The token cannot be read back;
# the first apply after the import records the configured one.
terraform import ankra_cloudflare_credential.main cloudflare-main
```
